annotations.title: Risk reports for up to 100 properties

description:
`property_risk_report` for up to 100 properties in one call, per-item
    outcomes (ok | not_found | error) in input order. Charged per property
    answered — the sum, never more.
    UK only. Costs 5 credits (5p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_risk_report_batch
